subject.title: fix(tts): allow trusted local media in message_tool_only mode

question: Should internally marked trusted local media be allowed to bypass message_tool_only room-event source suppression after all text and non-media fields are removed?
rationale: The patch is mechanically guarded and proven, but code and CI cannot decide whether this is the intended long-term privacy boundary for all trusted local tool media rather than TTS-specific provenance.

options.title: Accept the bounded bypass
options.body: Treat internal trustedLocalMedia provenance plus media-only reconstruction as sufficient authority for block and final room-event delivery.

options.title: Narrow bypass provenance
options.body: Require a dedicated TTS auto-delivery provenance marker or equivalent owner-issued capability instead of the generic trusted-local-media flag.

options.title: Keep suppression absolute
options.body: Do not permit automatic local media delivery in message-tool-only room events and retain explicit message-tool sends as the supported path.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded bypass
recommendation.body: Treat internal trustedLocalMedia provenance plus media-only reconstruction as sufficient authority for block and final room-event delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recently merged TTS operation-state work owns the closest block, final, tool, and message-tool-only delivery invariant on current main.
